overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent naming. The paper focuses on low-resource multi-hop question generation using a neural hidden semi-Markov model with reinforcement learning. Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, etc.) and human evaluation with clear criteria. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used.
